name: N³-tree with Brick Pool and Node Pool
definition: A hierarchical data structure for voxel rendering that combines an N³-tree for spatial subdivision with a brick pool for volume data and a node pool for tree structure, allowing efficient LOD and visibility culling.
summary: The N³-tree with Brick Pool and Node Pool is a GPU-friendly voxel rendering structure that uses a single pointer per node to reduce memory overhead and improve cache coherence during traversal.
